installed-runtime.command: dpkg-query -W; dpkg --audit; grep MemTotal /proc/meminfo; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online; /usr/bin/spe-smp-check; cat /tmp/visual-session.log

ssh-access.command: grep Uid /proc/self/status; ls -ld .ssh .ssh/authorized_keys; test -S /run/dbus/system_bus_socket && echo SYSTEM_DBUS_SOCKET_PRESENT
